intro: Auraline brings thoughtful organisation to modern bedrooms. With spacious shelves, secure storage, and a refined matte finish, it delivers a wardrobe designed for effortless everyday living.

features.title: Statement Grey Oak finish for contemporary elegance
features.text: The Grey Oak finish of Auraline brings a calm and sophisticated visual tone to your space. Additionally, the precoated finish enhances resistance to everyday wear while maintaining a smooth, refined appearance.

features.title: Multiple spacious shelves for effortless organisation
features.text: Auraline’s generously proportioned shelves offer ample room to store clothes, accessories, and everyday essentials. Every item finds its place, keeping your space consistently neat and easy to navigate.

features.title: Secure drawer with numeric lock for complete peace of mind
features.text: A built-in drawer with a numeric lock ensures your valuables remain safely stored and accessible only to you. The almirah offers reliable security without compromising its clean aesthetic.

features.title: Thoughtfully positioned hanging rod for everyday convenience
features.text: The hanging rod is placed at an ideal height, making it effortless to reach and organise your favourite outfits. This small detail can make your daily routine noticeably smoother.

features.title: Openable skirting for hassle-free maintenance
features.text: Designed for easy access at the base, the openable skirting makes cleaning simple and thorough. Your almirah stays fresh and well-maintained with minimal effort.

features.title: Soft matte finish for a refined, modern look
features.text: Auraline’s sophisticated matte surface adds a contemporary touch that blends seamlessly with any interior décor. This understated finish elevates the almirah from functional storage to a considered design addition.

name: Auraline Women Basic 2-Door Steel Almirah Precoated Grey Oak
